title: Everyday Phrases — Taking Out the Trash
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🗑️ 實用倒垃圾必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Taking Out the Trash
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的倒垃圾情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從廚房分類、打包下樓，到投放點分類與大件清運，全都用得上。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Taking Out the Trash phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering sorting in the kitchen, carrying bags downstairs, recycling at the drop-off point, and bulk pickup day. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have more trash bags?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are under the sink.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sort it into four kinds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper goes in the blue bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those go in the yellow bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glass goes in the green bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I throw away egg shells?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Egg shells go in food waste.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 廚餘就是指吃剩的食物？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will rinse this yogurt cup.
dialogue.zh: 我來把這個優格杯沖一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to dry it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Greasy boxes go in the trash.
dialogue.zh: 油膩的盒子丟一般垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep the old bags?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the small trash can?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不算，包裝紙是一般垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這樣才不會割傷人是嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不行，千萬別丟自家垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need more bags tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚還需要更多袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I add water to it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep it dry and closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, meat stays out of it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不行，有什麼問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice and bread are fine though.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I crush the cans too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, save room in the bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I peel the labels off?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stack the boxes by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll grab those on the way.
dialogue.zh: 出門時我們順手把它們搬走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bag is the trash one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have all the bags now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you tie the knot tight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I tied it nice and tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the bag up to test.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one holds, it is strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the bottles need a bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, bring them in the crate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will grab all the trash.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A note says it is broken.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My bag just scraped the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave your hand, it sees motion.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the lobby locks at ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 謝了，剛剛那個結嚇到我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a box hit the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 邊推邊把門往上抬一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The caretaker fixed them last month.
dialogue.zh: 管理員上個月才剛修過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Behind the building, past the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the path on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See the lamp above the bins?
dialogue.zh: 看到桶子上方的燈了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cat ran under the cars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each bin has a picture sign.
dialogue.zh: 每個桶子都有圖案標示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gray one shows a bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So gray takes the black bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the one with fish bones.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sticks when it is wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down it goes, with a thump.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the light green pail bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it by the green bin lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt baɪ ðə ɡrin bɪn lɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do caps stay on the bottles?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要蓋著，小蓋子容易不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it saves plenty of room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pour it out at the sink.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why no liquid in the bin?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼桶裡不能有液體？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those soft films go to stores.
dialogue.zh: 軟塑膠膜要送回商店收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our yellow bin cannot take them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stack it beside the blue lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 紙箱要綁膠帶還是繩子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個保麗龍盤能回收嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這個投放點不收保麗龍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glass jars need a rinse first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then drop them in the tall bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn drɑp ðɛm ɪn ðə tɔl bɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That bell shape is for glass?
dialogue.zh: 那個鐘形桶是收玻璃的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The green bin takes our pail.
dialogue.zh: 綠色桶負責我們的廚餘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open its flap and tip it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪts flæp ænd tɪp ɪt ɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 最後的碎屑都會掉出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do bags go in food waste?
dialogue.zh: 袋子可以跟著廚餘丟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個桶子裡會住進什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the flap must close well.
dialogue.zh: 所以那個小門一定要關好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rats can lift a loose lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 玉米芯丟堆肥還是灰桶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cobs are too hard, gray bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you tell them apart?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 摸起來軟軟的紙漿就是紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gray bin is filling up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bag burst on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是誰的？應該不是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們要順便整理一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are gloves in that little box?
dialogue.zh: 那個小箱子裡有手套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For spills only, the sign says.
dialogue.zh: 牌子上寫著，潑漏時才用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our leak happened on the stairs.
dialogue.zh: 我們剛才也在樓梯漏了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it once we are home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A click means it is shut.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the old shoe pair?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The donation box by the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no one splits them up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The box says clothes and shoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into gray, it is mixed waste.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 今晚沒有袋子在外面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 上週浣熊在這裡翻過垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 蓋緊的桶打敗聰明的浣熊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our boxes stay on the shelf.
dialogue.zh: 我們的紙箱放在架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off the wet grass, good call.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we carry the pail home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our record, last time was three.
dialogue.zh: 破紀錄了，上次只有三袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The elevator will be fixed soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last look at the lids.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All shut, now we walk in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 明天一大早收運車就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What time will we hear it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we roll bins out tonight.
dialogue.zh: 那今晚就得把桶子推出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like the arrow on the bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bins go to the street?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gray and blue, both of them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the pail waits six days.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lids keep our bags dry inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bulky means too big for bins?
dialogue.zh: 大件就是指桶子裝不下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stick it on the sofa side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can we drag it out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 週日晚上搬，卡車週一八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two people can tip it out.
dialogue.zh: 兩個人傾著搬就出得去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要用塑膠布包得嚴嚴實實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain would ruin the whole thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty it, leave the door open?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, open doors keep kids safe.
dialogue.zh: 對，才不會有小孩爬進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 落葉可以用塑膠袋裝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, paper bags only, it's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈpeɪpər bæɡz ˈoʊnli, ɪts ðə rul./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the town compost spot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Past the park, a big brown box.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ðə pɑrk, ə bɪɡ braʊn ˈbɑks./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dump it, then close the flap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is there a pile of dirt?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðɛr ə paɪl ʌv dɜrt?/
dialogue.zh: 旁邊為什麼堆著一攤土？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the smell sinks into dirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do worms live in that box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they turn waste to soil.
dialogue.zh: 對，牠們把廚餘變成肥土。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we take some for plants?
dialogue.zh: 可以拿一點回家養花嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 家裡的蒼蠅繞著果盤飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the fruit into the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we take trash out daily?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light mist, then close the lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pail bottom has gray juice.
dialogue.zh: 桶底積了一層灰灰的汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is compost tea, dilute it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone left bags beside the bins.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we write a kind note?
dialogue.zh: 我們寫張友善小公告好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rain will wash it clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The smell will be gone by then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɛl wɪl bi ɡɔn baɪ ðɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I set my alarm for five.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To wave at the truck driver?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to see the arm lift.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tu si ði ɑrm lɪft./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我兒子超愛那個轟隆聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 收運音樂七點前就結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The beeping wakes the whole street.
dialogue.zh: 倒車嗶聲會吵醒整條街。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 反正一週只吵一個早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will pull the bins back.
dialogue.zh: 車走後我會把桶子拉回。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bins nap in the shade again.
dialogue.zh: 桶子又在陰涼處睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have spare bags left?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole roll is in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl roʊl ɪz ɪn ðə drɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New bottles wait in the crate.
dialogue.zh: 新瓶子先在籃子裡放著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday night is our trash night.
dialogue.zh: 週五晚上是我們的垃圾夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the stairs will feel easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The truck comes at six sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close the window, it is chilly.
